description: Multiple Myeloma gene panel v1 — Sprint 1 pilot. Two groups: tumor-state (stratification anchors) and therapy-mechanism (SL partner candidates).

notes.tumor_state: Translocation/deletion-defined genes that stratify MM into subtypes. NSD2=t(4;14), CCND1=t(11;14), MAF/MAFB=t(14;16)/t(14;20). TP53/RB1/DIS3/FAM46C are recurrent deletions. These are the 'gene A' in the SL pair.
notes.therapy_mechanism: Direct targets of MM drug classes. CRBN/IKZF1/IKZF3=IMiD mechanism. BCL2/MCL1/PMAIP1=apoptotic rheostat. PSMD/PSMC=proteasome subunits (likely pan-essential, see audit). HDAC1/2 and BRD4=epigenetic co-dependencies. These are the 'gene B' in the SL pair.
notes.pan_essential_warning: PSMD1, PSMD2, PSMC1, VCP are pan-essential (>80% of all lines dependent). Engine will filter these from scoring. Proteasome axis pharmacology (bortezomib) is still scored against non-pan-essential partner genes.
notes.fam46c_absent: FAM46C is absent from DepMap 25Q2 CRISPR matrix. Included in panel for completeness but will produce no CRISPR signal.
notes.imid_caveat: IMiD mechanism (CRBN-mediated IKZF1/IKZF3 degradation) is not well-captured by IC50-based pharmacology. Lenalidomide is present in GDSC but results should be interpreted cautiously.
